{{Quote|Yes, yes. The rapier versus the broadsword. I've heard this argument before.|[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]|<ref name="Heavy Metal Jedi">{{CWACite|1|Heavy Metal Jedi}}</ref>}}
A '''broadsword''' was a type of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] used to strike powerful blows. It also served as a metaphor for a style of combat relying heavily on strength, in contrast to the [[rapier]].<ref name="Heavy Metal Jedi" />
